query:
ALTER TABLE `watchlists` MODIFY COLUMN `minConfidenceThreshold` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 25;
UPDATE `watchlists`
SET `minConfidenceThreshold` = 25
WHERE `minConfidenceThreshold` = 60;
UPDATE `scheduled_simulator_runs`
SET `minConfidence` = CASE `riskProfileId`
  WHEN 'conservative' THEN 35
  WHEN 'balanced' THEN 30
  WHEN 'aggressive' THEN 25
  ELSE `minConfidence`
END
WHERE `minConfidence` IN (64, 72, 82);
